Measured motor and propeller data

Upload a CSV with throttle_pct,thrust_g,current_a and enter its test voltage. The curve applies to every matching motor and propeller pair in this build. The simulator interpolates the data and scales effective throttle for loaded battery voltage.

Diagnostics and clearance

Electrical and hover diagnostics

    Physical clearance

      Component overlap uses bounding boxes. Propellers are checked as swept disks. Inspect flagged areas in the viewport.

      Download local appBLAZE WORKSHOP / Browser-local project
      Simulation model

      Educational estimates use representative component specifications and estimated motor curves. Board views show logical signals. Connector order, firmware, protocol messages, and I²C addresses are outside this model. The Pixhawk 2.4.8 power module and MAIN outputs use simplified pin groups. The model resolves expected electrical connections and estimates battery sag, wire loss, ESC load, thrust and vertical motion with pitch and roll. It omits firmware, switching transients, thermal dynamics and lateral flight. Endurance assumes 80% usable battery capacity.
